text:
Hello to night team,
The day crew brought up something about shift swaps overnight

I am sorry to ask for extra attention so late in the cycle, but we need to keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk aligned with the boarding notes that came in from the welfare coordinator. <<FACT F042>> Please make sure any handoff remarks are written clearly, especially when a traveler has asked for a quieter staging area, extra bedding, or a check from the service team before departure. If the record looks thin, add a brief note and flag it for follow up rather than leaving it to the next shift.

We also need tighter coordination on the pet handling side so the team on the ground is not left guessing. <<FACT F052>> Please keep any updates short and factual, and pass them along in the same thread so the day crew can see what was confirmed and what still needs review. If you spot a mismatch between the booking notes and the welfare plan, send it back at once so we can correct it before it grows into a larger problem.

I appreciate the extra care each of you gives to companion travel, and I am sorry that this has landed on your side without more lead time. Our goal is still dependable service for every animal and every traveler, and careful note keeping is part of that promise. Please stay alert, keep the tone calm, and hand over any unresolved items with enough detail for the next planner to act without delay.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
